threshold_source_note: v8.16: static model B = MobileNetV3-Large Siamese/triplet trained on own 55-participant dataset (round 1 of 5: own test participants [1, 3, 11, 15, 16, 20, 24, 25, 29, 42, 47] never seen) + 80 UTSig participants with cross-day pairs (35 UTSig participants held out). Default thresholds = EER point on the 11 unseen own participants (used with fewer than 7 references). Bounds = 1st-99th percentile of the personal thresholds of the 11 unseen own + 35 held-out UTSig participants, widened 10%.
